author: Vitor
notes: Could have potentially improved by keeping a `pow10` variable (with `*= 10` on every iteration) and avoiding the `Math.pow` call.
aiExplanation: This function iterates over the digits of `n` from right to left using `% 10` and `Math.floor(n / 10)`, **skipping any zero digits** entirely; for each non-zero digit it appends it to a new number `x` (built up via `count` as a power-of-ten position tracker) and adds it to a running `sum`, then finally returns the product `x * sum`.
